title: Okou
summary: A cloud personal agent for email, document writing, and scheduling.
description: Okou is a cloud personal agent that helps you manage email, write documents, and organize your schedule. Sign in to your Okou account and choose a workspace. Hold Enter to record a voice message and release to send it. Read responses on the handheld, scroll through longer replies, or revisit earlier messages with the arrow keys. This edition receives updates through the Cardputer Zero AppStore.
